item.title: Fresh bomb threats disrupt at least 18 flights across Europe
item.body: At least 18 flights to or from Bulgaria, Czechia, France, Italy, Hungary, Cyprus, Romania, the UK and Portugal were disrupted. All planes landed safely and searches found no explosive devices. The alerts appear to be part of a coordinated effort.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ✈️ Fresh bomb threats disrupt at least 18 flights across Europe

At least 18 flights to or from Bulgaria, Czechia, France, Italy, Hungary, Cyprus, Romania, the UK and Portugal were disrupted. All planes landed safely and searches found no explosive devices. The alerts appear to be part of a coordinated effort.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 6 November, 13:50

#BreakingNews #BombThreats #AirTravel
